about: An open source webshop for hosting companies, with billing and client management.

prs.title: Coupons now work through their last day
prs.broken: A coupon expiring today was rejected from midnight, because the expiry date was read as the very start of that day. One applied the day before stopped working at checkout.
prs.changed: A coupon now stays valid until the end of its expiry date and is rejected from the next day.
prs.matters: Customers get the discount for the whole last day the shop promised.
